scope: GitHub-only incremental release. Platform, real-model and isolated local evidence are separated.

knownNonBlockingHolds.test: light commands start fast; a task reaches the model quickly
knownNonBlockingHolds.reason: The original 1000 ms first-model threshold was not met. Alternating baseline/current runs on the same host both missed it while completing successfully. No assertion or threshold was relaxed.

sourceRegression.scope: Every selected source test file was run. Original failures remain recorded. Failed files were repeated serially. The review whitelist explicitly adds the read-only checker and a non-mutating assertion; other assertions and per-test deadlines are unchanged. The outer file watchdog permits the complete installer matrix to finish.

sourceBinding.scope: The only post-build change extends the exact read-only review-tool assertion. All runtime source/docs bytes and the selected packaged-test sources are unchanged; original package and upgrade receipts retain their build commit.

packagedRuntime.scope: Actual unpacked archive, packaged kernel only, copied unmodified tests, disposable HOME

macOSUpgrade.scope: Actual macOS installer and updater, disposable HOME, existing Node, no global PATH change

realModel.scope: Bounded real MiniMax provider calls through the native source runtime in disposable local projects. These precede the final release freeze and do not claim installed-archive, Windows, GUI, mail-provider or website acceptance.
